entries.name: Anthropic Python SDK
entries.use_for: Call Claude models from Python: messages, streaming, tool use, batches
entries.why: Official Python client for the Claude API; counterpart to the TS SDK already listed, typed and kept in step with the API

entries.name: Anthropic TypeScript SDK
entries.use_for: Official TypeScript client for the Anthropic Claude API, including streaming and tool use.
entries.why: Official vendor SDK for Claude, typed end to end and updated alongside API releases.

entries.name: Ax
entries.use_for: Build LLM programs with DSPy-style signatures and automatic prompt optimization in TypeScript.
entries.why: The most complete DSPy port for TypeScript; supports many providers and typed signatures instead of hand-written prompts.

entries.name: BitNet
entries.use_for: Run 1-bit (ternary) LLMs fast on CPUs and GPUs
entries.why: Microsoft's official inference framework for BitNet b1.58 models; optimized kernels make large models usable on commodity CPUs.

entries.name: Google Gen AI SDK (JS)
entries.use_for: Call Gemini models from TypeScript/JavaScript, incl. Live API and Vertex AI
entries.why: Official unified Gemini SDK for JS (replaces @google/generative-ai); covers both the Gemini API and Vertex AI

entries.name: Google Gen AI SDK (Python)
entries.use_for: Call Gemini models from Python against the Gemini API or Vertex AI
entries.why: Official unified Python SDK for Gemini; the supported replacement for google-generativeai

entries.name: Hugging Face JS
entries.use_for: Call Hugging Face Inference Providers and the Hub from JavaScript
entries.why: Official JS client for HF inference (many providers behind one API) and Hub access

entries.name: Instructor
entries.use_for: Get validated, typed structured outputs from any LLM via Pydantic models
entries.why: Most widely used structured-output layer for LLMs; works across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and local models

entries.name: KTransformers
entries.use_for: Run huge MoE LLMs locally with hybrid CPU/GPU offloading
entries.why: Heterogeneous inference that runs DeepSeek-class MoE models on a single GPU plus system RAM; exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs.

entries.name: LiteLLM
entries.use_for: Call 100+ LLM APIs through one OpenAI-format interface, as a Python SDK or a self-hosted gateway.
entries.why: Widely adopted unified client/proxy with cost tracking, fallbacks and rate limits; MIT outside its enterprise/ folder.

entries.name: LitGPT
entries.use_for: Pretrain, finetune and serve 20+ open LLMs with simple recipes
entries.why: Lightning AI's hackable from-scratch implementations of popular LLMs with LoRA/QLoRA, FSDP and serving recipes.

entries.name: llama.cpp
entries.use_for: Run open-weight LLMs locally on CPU/GPU with GGUF models and an OpenAI-compatible server
entries.why: The engine under Ollama, LM Studio and most local-LLM tools; broadest hardware and model support

entries.name: LM Studio SDK
entries.use_for: Load and call local models running in LM Studio from TypeScript.
entries.why: Official SDK for LM Studio, with model management, structured output and tool use against local models.

entries.name: Mistral TypeScript SDK
entries.use_for: Call Mistral models (chat, embeddings, OCR, agents) from TypeScript
entries.why: Official Mistral client for TypeScript

entries.name: MNN
entries.use_for: Run LLMs and other models on-device on mobile, embedded and desktop
entries.why: Alibaba's battle-tested lightweight inference engine; powers on-device LLMs in production apps with CPU/GPU/NPU backends.

entries.name: Ollama
entries.use_for: Run open-weight LLMs locally behind a simple REST and OpenAI-compatible API.
entries.why: The most popular way to pull and serve local models; large model library and SDKs for JS and Python.

entries.name: OpenAI Node SDK
entries.use_for: Official TypeScript/JavaScript client for the OpenAI API (chat, responses, embeddings, audio, images).
entries.why: Official vendor SDK, generated from the OpenAI API spec and kept in lockstep with new endpoints.

entries.name: OpenAI Python SDK
entries.use_for: Official Python client for the OpenAI API, sync and async.
entries.why: Official vendor SDK; many OpenAI-compatible servers (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio) accept it too, so one client covers many backends.

entries.name: OpenLLM
entries.use_for: Serve open-source LLMs as OpenAI-compatible API endpoints
entries.why: One command turns Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen etc. into an OpenAI-compatible server, built on BentoML for cloud deployment.

entries.name: Outlines
entries.use_for: Guarantee LLM output matches a JSON schema, regex or grammar
entries.why: Leading constrained-decoding library; its approach is used inside vLLM and other servers for structured generation

entries.name: TanStack AI
entries.use_for: Type-safe, provider-agnostic TypeScript SDK for streaming chat, tool calling and agents.
entries.why: From the TanStack team; framework-agnostic and strongly typed, a lighter alternative to the Vercel AI SDK.

entries.name: TensorRT-LLM
entries.use_for: Optimize and serve LLMs on NVIDIA GPUs with a Python API
entries.why: NVIDIA's official LLM inference stack: in-flight batching, paged KV cache, FP8/FP4 quantization and speculative decoding for max GPU throughput.

license_verified.note: LICENSE states Apache 2.0 with third-party notices appended

entries.name: TOON
entries.use_for: Encode JSON for LLM prompts in a compact, token-efficient format
entries.why: Token-Oriented Object Notation spec with TS SDK and CLI; cuts prompt tokens for tabular/structured data vs JSON, with benchmarks.

entries.name: Vercel AI SDK
entries.use_for: Call any LLM provider from TypeScript with streaming, tool calls, structured output and React/Svelte/Vue chat hooks.
entries.why: Provider-agnostic TS toolkit with first-class UI hooks; the de facto default for AI features in Next.js and other JS apps.

entries.name: vLLM
entries.use_for: Serve open-weight LLMs at high throughput behind an OpenAI-compatible API
entries.why: De facto standard for self-hosted GPU LLM serving (PagedAttention, continuous batching)

entries.name: WebLLM
entries.use_for: Run LLMs fully in the browser via WebGPU with an OpenAI-style API.
entries.why: Leading in-browser inference engine; no server needed, so it suits private or offline AI features in web apps.
